proposals.title: Stockholder Proposal Regarding Equal Shareholder Voting Give Each Share an Equal Vote
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a recapitalization plan giving one vote per share, phasing out the disproportionate voting rights of Class B shares.
proposals.evidence: OUR BOARD OF DIRECTORS RECOMMENDS A VOTE AGAINST THE STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL.
